scope: Composite integration validation; scalar eager-reference diagnostics establish bounded correctness, not universal compile support or CUDA performance gains.

build312.reason: Unused initial wheel built with host Python 3.12.14+meta before the managed build; its former .venv was subsequently replaced.

rust-debug.reason: Host Python lacked the static libpython required by PyO3; the managed-interpreter debug run supersedes this setup failure.

python-full312.reason: Initial full GPU run: documented CLI used an uninstalled environment; the stack validator rejected the noncanonical environment path. Corrected CLI/stack checks and canonical full suites supersede these setup failures.

python-full314.reason: Initial full portable run rejected a noncanonical virtualenv path in the stack validator.

python-full312-portable.reason: A symlinked .venv still fails the stack validator real-directory contract; canonical environment checks supersede this attempt.

python-full314-final.reason: Interrupted after confirming the symlinked environment cannot satisfy the stack validator; rerun fully with a real .venv.

provenance314.reason: Initial audit incorrectly required the reused read-only base interpreter to be inside the worktree; the corrected audit records its actual identity and hash.

cuda-math.reason: Initial evaluator run correctly awarded zero because its direct-source import contract requires the built extension in python/torch_rs; after copying the verified wheel extension, a fresh corrected measurement supersedes it.

rust-cuda.reason: Command used nonexistent cuda_neg test target; corrected invocation includes cuda_add, cuda_mul_scalar and cuda_native_boundaries.

scope_note: Superseded setup records retain their original timestamps and paths as historical attempts, not current runtime/build claims. Successful managed builds, canonical full suites and refreshed diagnostics supply current evidence. No implementation or test assertion changed.

known_gate_failure.result: 160 library tests passed, two NaN-payload assertions failed; unchanged test names and all assertion values match the preserved source baseline. Assertions are unchanged.

independent_gates: Author integration checks only; Burner independent review, calibrated evaluation and delivery gates remain separate and are not waived.

documentation_check.result: 52 checks, OK; includes final descriptive coverage and evidence links.

raw_record_path_conventions.commands: Relative command paths resolve against each receipt cwd.

math-build-record.json.note: Raw build-record relative paths retain their original measured-file location; the archive copy does not rewrite provenance.
